subject: Community Preservation Act Ordinance Amendments
overview: The Committee of the Whole discussed proposed amendments to the city's Community Preservation Act ordinance regarding vacancy recruitment and project resubmission rules. The committee voted to report the amendments out to the regular city council meeting.

items.title: Community Preservation Act Ordinance Amendments (Paper 22-519)
items.summary: The committee voted to report out proposed amendments to the Community Preservation Act ordinance to the regular city council meeting following a presentation on streamlining vacancy postings, project resubmissions, and board membership rules.
